task.description: Validate that PAR-01, PAR-02, PAR-03, PAR-04 (stage 16, monthly-range event-store partitioning) meet all MUST acceptance criteria and applicable NFRs before release. TEST-RUNNER Step 4 PASSED with all 6 batch-specific targets at expected counts (test-partition-attach 2/2, test-partition-maintenance 5/5, test-partition-retention 4/4, test-integration-par02 3/3, test-integration-par03 4/4, test-integration-event-store 29/29) plus full unit suite clean (1067/1131, 0 failures). One rework cycle occurred earlier (PAR-01 AC4 PartitionMissingForWrite, found missing by TEST-DESIGNER, fixed by BACKEND-DEV, independently re-verified by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Known, documented, non-blocking MINOR gaps remain: PAR-02 AC3, PAR-03 AC4/AC5, PAR-04 AC3/AC4 (correct implementations, thin/no direct test coverage) and PAR-02 AC5/PAR-03 AC6 (event emission -- TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR reclassified this MAJOR since the emission call sites are genuinely absent, not just untested, but agreed it should not block this gate since it is already filed as ISS-0670/GH-711, open, and the underlying requirement text is not falsely marked RELEASED). Confirm whether these gaps are acceptable to release against, or should block.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST AC in PAR-01/02/03/04 is verified against the actual passing test evidence, not just trusted from the handoff chain
Confirm ISS-0670/GH-711 (PAR-02 AC5/PAR-03 AC6 emission gap) is correctly scoped as non-blocking for this release (requirement not falsely marked RELEASED, issue is open/tracked)
Any applicable NFRs (performance, if any specified for these requirements) checked
Release decision written to docs/status/ per Output File Format Rules (.yaml)

result.summary: Independently re-verified PAR-01/02/03/04 by reading exact AC text from docs/requirements.yaml, reading tests/specs/PAR-01..04.md in full, and re-running all 6 batch-specific build targets myself against the live db_test container (test-partition-attach 2/2, test-partition-maintenance 5/5, test-partition-retention 4/4, test-integration-par02 3/3, test-integration-par03 4/4, test-integration-event-store 29/29, test-env-verify HEALTHY 10/10) -- all match the report exactly. PAR-01 and PAR-04: PASS, all MUST ACs implemented and proven (independently confirmed REWORK 1 PAR-01 AC4 fix, commit fa63e32d, is real by reading store.zig/errors.zig directly). PAR-02 and PAR-03: PARTIAL. Independently grepped src/ and confirmed EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED (PAR-02 AC5) and EXECUTION_PARTITION_DETACHED/DROPPED (PAR-03 AC6) have zero call sites anywhere in source -- this is missing implementation, not missing test coverage, and both are plain MUST-priority AC bullets with no qualifying language distinguishing them from the other ACs in the same requirement. Per the governing anti-pattern rule (RELEASE-VALIDATOR MUST FAIL a MUST AC with no passing test evidence -- stronger here since there is no implementation to test), these two specific ACs cannot be counted as met even though ISS-0670/GH-711 is correctly filed, OPEN, and correctly scoped as needing a CODE-DESIGNER design note (no platform/system instance_id convention exists for the event-store append path). Checked NFR applicability: no PAR-0x benchmark exists in tests/bench/bench.zig, no new HTTP endpoint is introduced by this batch, so NFR-01/02/04 are correctly not applicable; PAR-04 AC1/AC3's embedded 50ms/1s timing thresholds are self-measured at runtime and were exercised transitively across 36 re-run test cases with zero AttachScanRequired triggers, confirming the fast path held.

issues.description: PAR-02 AC5 and PAR-03 AC6 (EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED / EXECUTION_PARTITION_DETACHED / EXECUTION_PARTITION_DROPPED event emission) are unimplemented in src/, confirmed by direct grep. Tracked as ISS-0670/GH-711 (OPEN). Recommend DOC-UPDATER mark PAR-02/PAR-03 as tested-with-known-gap rather than unqualified RELEASED, referencing ISS-0670/GH-711, while PAR-01 and PAR-04 proceed to full RELEASED.

result.next_action: Route to DOC-UPDATER (Step 6): RELEASE PAR-01 and PAR-04 in full. Mark PAR-02 and PAR-03 tested-with-known-gap (not unqualified RELEASED) pending ISS-0670/GH-711, recording the specific unmet AC (PAR-02 AC5, PAR-03 AC6) against the tracking issue.
